text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—Gotta go with Yamanin Zephyr for today's Yasuda Kinen.
Her recent growth has been totally out of this world!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, you can't underestimate Ikuno Dictus.
She's on a whole other level when it comes to experience!"

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text:
"—Based on the above data, Yamanin Zephyr's
growth rate is exceptionally high, and her
threat assessment remains at the maximum level."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...Looking at the numbers, Zephyr's growth curve
closely mirrors McQueen's."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as Ikuno Dictus said, Yamanin Zephyr's tremendous rate of growth was something familiar to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If IRON WILL's evaluation values are correct, Yamanin Zephyr is showing growth equivalent to two years for an average Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text:
"In addition to Yamanin Zephyr, Mejiro McQueen,
and Ikuno Dictus, other Umamusume exhibiting
similar singular growth patterns have been observed—"

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text:
"It is possible that an unprecedented, interactive growth spurt is currently being triggered among active Umamusume.
The cause remains unknown."
choice_data_list: ...What a crazy era this is, huh?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: However, that is a joyous thing.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is growing beyond our expectations.
Which means the future is all the more unpredictable, in the best possible way.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"It is better that way.
...To realize the future we are aiming for."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The future I aim for with Ikuno Dictus—a world where every Umamusume can keep running as long as she wishes—is that grand of a goal.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ......Well, I suppose I should be heading off soon.
choice_data_list: Let's show them how strong you are in mile races!
Let's show them how strong you are in mile races!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus... To think she just ran the Tenno Sho (Spring)
and is already doing this... It's incredible.
She's in absolutely top form, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
That 'who cares about distance' attitude is so cool...!
Go get 'em, Ikuno Dictus—!
Just like the breeze and the moon... so to speak.

text_block_list.name: Sound of Strong Wind
text_block_list.text: (WHOOOOOSH――――)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Zephyr-san...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (A different kind from McQueen's... This... this presence is like an aura—)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Or an unbending iron will standing strong
against raging, howling winds—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Defeating you as you pierce through the tempest and creating a gust of my own... It seems it won't be as gentle as a soft Japanese breeze.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...I also feel it will be no easy feat.
Defeating you, that is.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Whoa...! Ikuno Dictus looks like she isn't giving Yamanin Zephyr an inch! This is gonna be good!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Let us ascertain it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Before the Takarazuka Kinen, show me how you run now...!
